auditor: Senior Production Security Reviewer & Deployment Auditor

findings.evidence: backend/config/env.js defaultOrigins lists Vercel preview domains and localhost, but omits 'https://varanasiyatra.com'
findings.risk: Requests from official domain https://varanasiyatra.com will be blocked by CORS unless ALLOWED_ORIGINS env var is explicitly set in production host
findings.recommendedFix: Add 'https://varanasiyatra.com' to defaultOrigins array and ensure ALLOWED_ORIGINS is injected in production hosting environment
findings.productionImpact: CORS rejection on production website if env variable omitted

findings.evidence: MongoDB scan found 78 test enquiries, 26 test users, 40 test vendors, and 4 test bookings in active database
findings.risk: Deploying with existing database pollutes CRM operational queues with mock and test artifacts
findings.recommendedFix: Point production to a fresh dedicated production MongoDB Atlas cluster or execute a clean pre-production migration script
findings.productionImpact: Operators see clutter and dummy leads on Day 1

findings.evidence: backend/server.js initializeUsers() seeds CEO and Manager using fallback passwords if env vars are unset
findings.risk: Default initial credentials could be used if CEO_INITIAL_PASSWORD and MANAGER_INITIAL_PASSWORD are not set in production env
findings.recommendedFix: Mandate CEO_INITIAL_PASSWORD and MANAGER_INITIAL_PASSWORD in env.js validation during production startup
findings.productionImpact: Potential default credential risk if env vars omitted

findings.evidence: backend/server.js loginLimiter max is set to 500 requests per 15 minutes
findings.risk: 500 attempts in 15 minutes is permissive against dedicated credential stuffing attacks
findings.recommendedFix: Reduce production loginLimiter to 15-30 requests per 15-minute window

findings.evidence: backend/package.json includes firebase-tools as a direct production dependency (pulling superstatic, exegesis, etc.)
findings.risk: Heavy CLI dev-tools increase attack surface and trigger npm audit warnings in production container
findings.recommendedFix: Move firebase-tools to devDependencies or manage Firebase CLI globally in CI/CD pipeline
findings.productionImpact: Bloated production image and unnecessary third-party package exposure

findings.evidence: src/constants/crm.js defaults BASE_URL to Google Cloud Run URL 'https://api-gzo7qrxiuq-uc.a.run.app' in PROD if VITE_API_BASE_URL is unset
findings.risk: If building for a different backend server without passing VITE_API_BASE_URL, frontend will attempt to connect to Cloud Run instance
findings.recommendedFix: Ensure VITE_API_BASE_URL is explicitly set during the frontend build step in CI/CD / hosting provider
findings.productionImpact: Frontend connects to wrong backend if build env var omitted

findings.evidence: Nodemailer is configured for Gmail service using EMAIL_USER/EMAIL_PASS; if unset, deliveryStatus returns SMTP_NOT_CONFIGURED
findings.risk: Automated password resets and customer inquiry emails will not dispatch until production SMTP/SendGrid credentials are provided
findings.recommendedFix: Configure production SMTP credentials (e.g. SendGrid, Amazon SES, or Brevo) in hosting environment
findings.productionImpact: Manual password reset required until SMTP credentials added

findings.risk: Lack of strict Content-Security-Policy header increases susceptibility to potential inline script injection
findings.recommendedFix: Define a tailored CSP policy with allowed script-src and connect-src directives

findings.evidence: No centralized Express error-handling middleware mounted at end of backend/server.js
findings.risk: Uncaught asynchronous errors in non-try/catch route handlers could trigger default Express HTML responses or unhandled rejections
findings.recommendedFix: Mount app.use((err, req, res, next) => ...) at bottom of middleware stack
findings.productionImpact: Suboptimal error response formatting for unexpected exceptions

findings.evidence: GET /admin/enquiries queries all 10 booking/enquiry collections into Node memory before slicing pagination
findings.risk: At high volume (100k+ records), in-memory collection aggregation could create memory pressure
findings.recommendedFix: Implement database-level pagination ($facet or single-collection indexed query) for long-term scalability
findings.productionImpact: Higher memory consumption under heavy lead volumes
